writerAuthority: Existing ChampionshipPersistentSavePort; manual save and existing successful capture-to-Home transaction

addition.seeds: Canonical signed 32-bit words; validation also accepts equivalent unsigned 32-bit input
addition.cursors: 0..103 inclusive; original roll wraps 103 to zero before reading
addition.copyBoundary: RNG snapshots, normalization and restoration copy both arrays; no external mutable references

lifecycle.owner: championshipStandaloneApp only, reusing battleRngChannel algorithm; no second store or save authority
lifecycle.newGame: Initialize once using platform local hour/minute/second. CPU-proven seed is their sum, or 1 for all-zero time. This platform input is separate from the Raising game calendar
lifecycle.draw: nextGameplayRandom validates the channel before initialization, advances the owned sequence and marks the existing save dirty
lifecycle.navigation: Gate selection, Hunt start/exit and other navigation do not reset this state
lifecycle.continue: Validate before replacing an open session; restore both arrays, without reading the platform clock
lifecycle.legacy: v1/v2/v3 migration preserves absent history as null. Read, canContinue and Continue do not invent it; the first native draw initializes a new clock-based sequence. It cannot recover historical original draws
lifecycle.failure: Failed storage writes leave the old durable checkpoint and current in-memory sequence intact; app retry saves current state
lifecycle.captureCommit: RNG joins the existing candidate Home/identity write; draws are refused during the synchronous capture commit
